faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

Do you work as a farmhouse interior designer for clients based in Hauz Khas?

Yes. Many Hauz Khas families own farmhouses in Chhattarpur, Sultanpur and nearby areas. We design those homes and coordinate site visits around your schedule.

What style suits a farmhouse near South Delhi?

Most clients prefer a warm, relaxed style with natural wood, stone, large windows and open living areas that lead out to the lawns. We adjust the mix to your taste.

Can the farmhouse be planned for events and guests?

Yes. We plan flexible seating, guest suites, outdoor dining and service routes so gatherings run smoothly without disturbing the family's private rooms.

How is a farmhouse interior designer different from a city-home designer?

Farmhouses have larger spaces, outdoor areas and heavy seasonal use, so materials, storage and lighting are planned differently from a city apartment.
